sets.title: Recognize
sets.description: Identify parenthetical expressions by function and choose the correct one for each context
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите вводные слова по функции и выберите подходящее для каждого контекста

items.prompt: Certainty: _____, он придёт вовремя. Он никогда не опаздывает.
items.promptEnglish: Of course, he will come on time. He is never late.
items.hint: The speaker is confident, reinforced by 'he is never late.'
items.explanation: Конечно (of course) expresses certainty. The second sentence confirms the speaker's confidence.

items.prompt: Emotion: _____, мы не успели купить билеты.
items.promptEnglish: Unfortunately, we did not manage to buy the tickets.
items.hint: The speaker expresses regret about the situation.
items.explanation: К сожалению (unfortunately) is an emotional parenthetical expressing the speaker's regret. It is always set off by a comma.

items.promptEnglish: In my opinion, this film is overrated.
items.hint: The speaker shares a personal viewpoint, not a general fact.
items.explanation: По-моему (in my opinion) attributes the statement to the speaker's personal view. Compare with как известно, which references common knowledge.

items.prompt: Which parenthetical expresses strong certainty without any doubt?
items.explanation: Безусловно (undoubtedly, certainly) is the strongest certainty marker among common parentheticals. It leaves no room for doubt.

minimalPairs.context: A friend is guessing where Лена went:
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Choose the version that expresses uncertainty.
minimalPairs.explanation: Наверное (probably) signals the speaker's uncertainty. Without it, the sentence states Lena's departure as established fact.

minimalPairs.context: A lecturer making a strong claim about a scientific finding:
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Choose the version expressing no doubt.
minimalPairs.explanation: Безусловно (undoubtedly) reinforces the speaker's absolute certainty. Without it, the sentence is a prediction but not an emphatic one.

minimalPairs.context: An author presenting a personal take on a novel:
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Choose the version that marks a personal opinion.
minimalPairs.explanation: По-моему (in my opinion) signals a subjective judgment. Without it, the sentence reads as an objective claim.

sets.title: Build & Correct
sets.description: Build sentences with parentheticals from word tiles, then fix comma-placement errors
sets.descriptionRussian: Составьте предложения с вводными словами, затем исправьте ошибки в расстановке запятых

errorCorrection.hint: A parenthetical in mid-sentence position must be enclosed in commas.
errorCorrection.explanation: Конечно is a parenthetical expression (вводное слово) and must be set off by commas on both sides when placed mid-sentence: Он, конечно, придёт завтра.

errorCorrection.sentence: К сожалению мы опоздали на рейс.
errorCorrection.hint: A parenthetical at the start of a sentence needs a comma after it.
errorCorrection.explanation: К сожалению (unfortunately) at the beginning must be followed by a comma before the main clause continues.

translation.english: Of course, we will finish the project on time.
translation.hint: Use конечно or разумеется for 'of course.' Remember the comma after the parenthetical.
К сожалению for 'unfortunately.' Comma follows the parenthetical.
Use наверное (probably) in mid-sentence with commas on both sides.

translation.english: In the opinion of doctors, this medicine is safe.
translation.answer: По мнению врачей, это лекарство безопасно.
acceptableVariants: Это лекарство, по мнению врачей, безопасно.
translation.hint: По мнению + genitive noun for 'in the opinion of.' Comma after the parenthetical.
